Title: UDI-001 Baseline — Chrome clean profile
Preconditions: KASM Ubuntu; Chrome default profile; no extensions
Steps:
1. Open https://gdtm-dev.globalsiteanalytics.com/index.html
2. Wait for Collected Payload and Copy Payload
3. Capture payload (automation or manual)
4. Repeat 5x same session / 5x fresh profile per test design
Expected Result: Payload non-empty; length stable within documented tolerance; Copy succeeds
